mem* byte count hardcodes an element stride (in_stack_00000028 << 2) instead of count * sizeof(*dst). If the array holds pointers this corrupts it on the 64-bit build (a *4 moves half of each 8-byte pointer); for value arrays use sizeof for self-documentation.
